text: As a senior student at this university who spends considerable time reading in the library, I am writing this letter with the aim of putting forward some constructive suggestions to improve the current facilities and services.
Having observed the daily study environment, I would like to lay emphasis on the following aspects.
In the first place, it is exceedingly advisable that the administration prolong the opening hours during examination weeks to accommodate students' intense revision schedules.
In the second place, the library is expected to introduce more power outlets and create designated silent study cubicles.
Lastly, regular maintenance of academic databases and book resources should be reinforced to ensure prompt access to references.
Thank you for your time and favorable consideration of my recommendations.
I am genuinely looking forward to your earliest reply at your convenience.
